body.p: Please add the following new paragraph after the title and before first paragraph entitled
"TECHNICAL FIELD" on page 1:
This application is a continuation of United States Patent Application No. 16/065,209, filed on
September June 22, 2018, which is U.S. National Phase of PCT/GB2016/054008, filed
December 21, 2016, which claimed priority to United Kingdom Application No. 1522672.3,
filed December 22, 2015, the disclosures of which are incorporated by reference as if set forth
fully herein.
Please replace the paragraph beginning at page 1, line 26 of the application as filed with
the following amended paragraph:
Electrical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) is a known technique that can be
used for assessing cervical pre-cancer as set out in, for example, W02006/129108
(Brown and Tidy) and WO 2006/129116 (Brown and Tidy). Other publications
concerning EIS for cervical investigations include:
Please add the following new paragraph with the following replacement paragraph, which
should appear after the paragraph ending at page 5, line 6 of the application as filed:
FIG. 2 is a schematic representation of an elongate probe and processing means for use as
an embodiment of the invention.
Please replace the paragraph beginning at page 7, line 1 of the application as filed with
the following amended paragraph:
In the illustrated embodiment, the accelerometer 7 is an ["]Analog
Devices["]® tri-axial MEMS device whose output is suitable for direct
connection to the microcontroller's analogue to digital converter circuit. The only
signal processing required is simple linear calibration for zero and range. The
calibrated tri-axial output of the accelerometer 7 is operated on by a rotation
matrix so that it can be accurately aligned with the longitudinal axis of the probe
1. Other methods of measuring the gravity vector resolved to the longitudinal axis
of the probe would be suitable for this application and understood by the skilled
reader.
Please replace the paragraph beginning at page 7, line 20, of the application as filed with
the following amended paragraph:
As illustrated in FIG. 2, the [[The]] processing means are provided, for
example, in the form of a PC 8which can record patient information, e.g., via a
recording means 9, guide the clinician through the measuring process, control the
probe, analyse and save the results in a database.
